text:
MGN 608 Amendment 1 (M+F) Radio Survey Service: Authorisation
Procedures for persons wishing to obtain authorisation to carry out radio surveys are explained.
Documents
Details
Notice to all Shipowners, Agents, Recognised Organisations, Certifying Authorities, Builders, Masters, Skippers and Officers.
This notice amends MGN608 (M+F) replacing MGN 392(M+F).
This MGN should be read in conjunction with List of authorised persons for radio surveys on UK flagged ships
